input.quote: the right to use, a computer system on which the Site will be stored and operated, with a direct Internet connection of shared but greater than T-1 bandwidth, plus capacity to process continuously during burst periods. HDI shall also provide the Company with access to HDI's software and Content administration tools for purposes of allowing the Company to monitor current catalog information.
input.rationale:
Section 1.4 (p0008-p0009) is the only grant of use rights running to us (access to and the right to use HDI's hosting system, software and Content administration tools; the sole other licence, in Section 6.1/p0038, runs from us to HDI for our Marks). The grant names only "the Company" — our affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf are neither included nor given any mechanism (e.g. written notice) to be added, which fails the fallback position on a material term, even though the licence is not expressed to be revocable at HDI's discretion and Section 10.3 (Assignment) already carries the Agreement to our successors and assigns, satisfying the transferability limb. The proposed minimal edit adds affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf and confirms the right is irrevocable during the term; we have not re-flagged the mutual 90-day termination right in Section 4.1, which is a separate commercial term.</parationale>
<parameter name="confidence">0.78

proposal.summary: Extend the Section 1.4 use rights to the Company's affiliates and contractors and make them irrevocable during the term.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Section 1.4 right to use HDI's system, software and administration tools to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, and confirmed the right is irrevocable during the term, since our group entities and outsourced providers will operate and monitor the Site on our behalf. If preferred, we can instead cover affiliates on written notice to HDI.
